description: Golden tasks for George ReAct-loop evaluation. Mined from real Discord sessions (anonymized/standalone). Replayed through discord_generate_response in dry-run (Discord egress tokens invalidated).

tiers.smoke: fast regression subset (~15-20 min); nightly default
tiers.full: all tasks (~1.5-2 h); phase gates / on demand
